newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Labour MPs to meet Saturday on coalition.
newsitem.headline: NZ Labour MPs to meet Saturday on coalition.

text.p: New Zealand Labour leader Helen Clark said she was calling a meeting of her party's MPs on Saturday to brief them on the state of coalition negotiations with the New Zealand First party.
NZ First sources said that party's MPs were also on standby for a weekend meeting.
Clark was speaking after a two and a half hour meeting with New Zealand First leader Winston Peters.
Labour and the caretaker National Party government are both negotiating to form a coalition with nationalist New Zealand First, which holds the balance of power.

Parties are striving to clinch a deal before parliament convenes for the first time since the October 12 general election. Caretaker Prime Minister Jim Bolger said earlier the first session would take place on December 12.
